newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung building $900 mln display plant.
newsitem.headline: Samsung building $900 mln display plant.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Monday it had begun construction on a thin-film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) plant, which will require a $900 million investment over the next two years.
Samsung said in a statement that the company's third TFT-LCD line was scheduled for start-up in mid-1998.
The plant, located in Chonan south of Seoul, will be capable of processing 30,000 600mx720mm glass substrates a month.

Samsung said it would be the first company to adopt the 660x720mm size, chosen for its ability to produce six 13.3-inch extended graphics array display panels for notebook PCs from a single glass substrate.
The world TFT-LCD market was $6.5 billion in 1996 and is expected to jump to $10 billion this year, Samsung said.
